what_it_is.prose: BEL is India's flagship defence-electronics DPSU under the Ministry of Defence, headquartered in Bengaluru. It designs and manufactures radars (3D-CAR/Rohini/Revathi for Akash batteries; Rajendra PESA), ESM/EW, missile-system electronics, electro-optic/thermal-imaging sights (T-72, T-90, BMP), naval combat systems, ESM for submarines, comms, and the Akash Tarang indigenous counter-UAS electronic-warfare system inducted by the Indian Army in 2026. FY26 provisional turnover ~₹26,750 Cr with order book ~₹74,000 Cr. BEL is a co-producer (with BDL) of the Akash surface-to-air missile system and executed the first export of an Indian-made SAM battery to Armenia (Nov 2024). Subsidiaries include BEL-Thales Systems Limited (BTSL, JV with Thales) and BEL Optronic Devices Limited.

rows.india_status: BEL supplies Rajendra 3D PESA fire-control radar, 3D-CAR central acquisition radar (Rohini for IAF, Revathi for Navy); BDL is the missile prime. Indian military combined Akash orders ~₹28,800 Cr. BEL received ₹3,914 Cr Akash Prime order (Jun 2023). First export battery shipped to Armenia (Nov 2024) — India's second missile export after BrahMos
Indigenous electronic-warfare C-UAS developed for the Indian Army to detect, track, jam and neutralise hostile drones. Inducted 2026

Gunner TI sight for T-90, Commander TI sight for T-90, Commander TI sight for T-72 tank & BMP-1/2/2K ICV. BEL is the largest supplier of night-vision equipment to the Indian Armed Forces; 1,600 T-72s targeted for TI upgrade

3D Central Acquisition Radar developed by DRDO; BEL is production agency. Rohini for IAF (medium-range surveillance, Akash battery target acquisition), Revathi for Indian Navy; ~100+ radars in service
BEL's C-UAS soft/hard-kill system: real-time search, detection, tracking, neutralisation of flying drones
